selection.name: betterleaks
selection.role: C02: provisional primary detector for Git, filesystem and agent-invoked scans before publication; does not provide credential storage.
selection.install_source: The upstream README documents go install with @latest; this command pins that installation path to the reviewed v1.9.0 release.

basis.shows: Documents installation, Git/filesystem/stdin scanning, contextual filters and rule-based credential validation. These support capability fit, not measured accuracy superiority.
Released 2026-09-29, within 90 days; provides Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 artifacts. WSL2 compatibility is inferred from the Linux artifact.
Latest default-branch commit is 2026-09-30, satisfying the maintenance rule. Adds pre-receive blocking; inclusion in the selected release was not established.
Ubuntu and Windows CI builds the project, validates configuration and runs the Go test suite with race detection.
Test workflow succeeded on the latest default-branch commit on 2026-09-30; establishes passing CI, not comparative detection performance.
Pre-receive feature merged on 2026-09-30, demonstrating recent development and review activity.

not_selected.name: gitleaks
not_selected.reason: Strong unresolved alternative: documented pre-commit integration and passing latest-master tests; its latest release is older, with no measured accuracy advantage established. [README](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/blob/v8.30.1/README.md), [CI](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/actions/runs/29939776129), [release](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/tag/v8.30.1).

not_selected.name: trufflehog
not_selected.reason: Active validation-focused scanner, but additional coverage sufficient to justify a second detector was not demonstrated; inspected CI runs required approval. [README](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/blob/e28360875917c9c730f9c64aae29fb93aa6c359e/README.md), [Actions API](https://api.github.com/repos/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/actions/runs?per_page=8).

not_selected.name: ggshield
not_selected.reason: Useful Claude Code/Codex and Git hooks, but mandatory GitGuardian API authentication adds a service dependency; Linux credential-storage location and passing CI were unverified. [README](https://github.com/GitGuardian/ggshield/blob/841a768aa3255144b5cd2f518b21a1511a265eef/README.md), [release](https://github.com/GitGuardian/ggshield/releases/tag/v1.55.0).

not_selected.name: OpenBao
not_selected.reason: Current centralized secret manager, but the packet supplies no concrete multi-host or multi-operator sharing need to qualify its selection. [README](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/blob/a4f7e569875f836f246bf9e41aff984741a9693e/README.md), [release](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/releases/tag/v2.7.1).

excluded.name: noseyparker
excluded.fact: GitHub reports archived=true; the latest default-branch commit is 2026-02-21, outside 90 days, and announces retirement. [Repository API](https://api.github.com/repos/praetorian-inc/noseyparker), [commit](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/noseyparker/commit/2e6e7f36ce36619852532bbe698d8cb7a26d2da7).

layers.deciding_comparison: Betterleaks is a provisional preference based on features, release currency and verified CI. Compare Betterleaks v1.9.0 with Gitleaks v8.30.1 on the same seeded checkout and Git history under WSL2 Linux x86_64, repeating on macOS arm64. Measure secret recall, benign-file false positives, blocking before publication, latency, memory and secrets exposed in scanner output. This comparison remains unrun. Qualify OpenBao separately only after identifying a concrete multi-host/operator sharing need; broker credential handling remains a trading gate.
evidence_gaps: No all-arm comparison is recorded in the packet, and no reviewed benchmark establishes comparative accuracy or speed.
Requirement coverage is incomplete: the selected detector does not keep sign-ins or credentials outside the checkout through storage or injection. Those credential paths remain unverified.
WSL2 and macOS arm64 execution were not tested. Artifact availability supports platform fit; no GPU is required by this layer.
TruffleHog's inspected CI runs were action_required; OpenBao and ggshield passing CI were not verified. Issue triage quality was not established across all candidates.
A paid-service requirement for ggshield was not established, so it was not excluded on that criterion.
